title: USDE Short Interest in September 2026: How Much Was Shorted
headline: How much StablecoinX stock was sold short in September 2026?
name: USDE short interest review
description: Short sellers held 2.81 million USDE shares on September 30, 2026, 14.7% of the stock StablecoinX's prospectus counted as freely tradable in August. FINRA data.
imageAlt: Two panels on one time axis, June 26 to October 8, 2026, showing USDE's daily close and FINRA short interest at seven settlement dates, from 12,599 shares on June 30 to 2,810,986 on September 30.
